description: This Java interface defines the ConditionService for managing condition objects within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It specifies methods for retrieving, saving, voiding, unvoiding, and deleting condition records, with appropriate authorization annotations and exception handling.

classes.name: ConditionService
classes.description: Interface defining the contract for condition management in OpenMRS, extending OpenmrsService and including methods for condition retrieval, modification, and deletion.

methods.name: getConditionByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a condition object identified by its UUID, authorized with GET_CONDITIONS privilege.

methods.name: getActiveConditions
methods.description: Returns a list of active conditions for a specified patient, authorized with GET_CONDITIONS privilege.

methods.name: getAllConditions
methods.description: Retrieves all conditions (active and inactive) for a specified patient, introduced in version 2.2.1, authorized with GET_CONDITIONS privilege.

methods.name: getConditionsByEncounter
methods.description: Fetches all non-voided conditions associated with a particular encounter.

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Retrieves a condition by its internal ID, authorized with GET_CONDITIONS privilege.

methods.name: saveCondition
methods.description: Saves or updates a condition object, authorized with EDIT_CONDITIONS privilege.

methods.name: voidCondition
methods.description: Voids a condition with a given reason, making it inactive; requires EDIT_CONDITIONS privilege.

methods.name: unvoidCondition
methods.description: Revives a previously voided condition, requires EDIT_CONDITIONS privilege.

methods.name: purgeCondition
methods.description: Permanently deletes a condition from the database, requiring DELETE_CONDITIONS privilege.
